en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Ali Bin Al Hakam, from Muawiya Bin Maysara, from Al Hakam Bin Uteyba who said,

‘I saw Abu Ja’farasws and heasws had taken the henna and made it to be upon hisasws nails, so heasws said: ‘O Hakam! What are you saying regarding this?’ So I said, ‘What can I say and youasws have done it, and among us it is the youth who do it’. So heasws said: ‘O Hakam! When the nails are hit by the Noura, it changes them until they resemble the nails of the dead, therefore change it back by the henna’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from Ali ibn al-Hakam from Mu‘awiyah ibn Maysarah from al-Hakam ibn ‘Utaybah who has said the following:

“Once I saw abu Ja‘far, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, who had placed henna on his finger nails and asked me, ‘O Hakam, what do you say about it? I replied, ‘I cannot say anything when you have done so. In our town young people do so.’ He (the Imam) said, ‘O Hakam, when fingers touch lime paste their color change and they look like fingers of dead people but you can change that kind of change of color with henna.’””
